title: Aquazone: Desktop Life Option Disc Series 2: Black Molly
native_title: アクアゾーン・オプション・ディスク・シリーズ２ ～ブラック・モーリー～
overview: Aquazone: Desktop Life Option Disc Series 2: Black Molly is a Sega Saturn simulation game released exclusively in Japan. It is not technically a game, but rather a tropical fish simulator.
